## 6. Abdominals Choice

## 6a. Heel Touches

Exercise Objective: Develop strength in the abdominal muscles

## Start Position

1. Lie on the floor face up with arms straight at the sides, and palms flat
2. Bend knees keeping feet flat on the floor and pressing lower back into the floor

## Procedure
